director.text: tenth, seventh, quarter

Bilkul sahi, kyunki chocolate jitne zyada tukdon mein kate, tukda utna chhota; isliye pehle 1/10, phir 1/7, phir 1/4. Chalo, aaj ka ek aakhri sawaal, poore paath se. Is circle ke 9 barabar tukde hain, aur 4 tukdon mein rang hai. Rangin bhaag fraction mein kitna hai?

Sahi jawab. Aaj ki baat yeh thi ki kisi cheez ke barabar tukdon ka hi fraction naam hota hai, aur neeche wala number saare barabar tukde ginta hai. Phir bahut saari cheezon ka fraction aaya: neeche wala number batata hai kitne barabar group banane hain, aur ek group ki ginti jawab hoti hai. Aakhir mein dekha ki ek jaisi cheez jitne zyada barabar tukdon mein kate, har tukda utna chhota hota hai. Aaj tumne 1/4, 1/10 aur 1/7 ko sabse chhote se sabse bade tak lagaya. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain!
